summary: Collapsed `hideWidgetForGood` from the twelve-line converted-widget hack to `widget.setHidden(true)`. Gone with it: the `origType`/`origComputeSize`/`origSerializeValue` save-and-restore (nothing in this pack ever read them back, so the widget could never be un-hidden), the `[0,-4]` computeSize magic number, the `widget.type` overwrite — `type` is identity, and hiding was always the real intent — and the `suffix`/`linkedWidgets` recursion, which existed only to propagate the mangled type string. This helper has zero callers anywhere in the pack, so no caller is stranded; the remaining thirteen exports (chainCallback, getSlotPos, clientToCanvas, watchImageInputs, …) are untouched and keep their signatures for the siblings still importing them.

test:
equivalence: Calling the pack's hide helper on a node's widget makes that widget stop occupying space on the node while leaving its value untouched, and leaves every other widget on the node visible. Passes on both the original (widget.type = "converted-widget", computeSize = () => [0,-4]) and the converted source (node.widgets.get(name).setHidden(true)). The other exports of this module — chainCallback, makeUUID, clientToCanvas, getNodeAtPoint, typesCompatible, getSlotPos, addMiddleClickPan, resolveSourcePreview, watchImageInputs, captureVideoFrame, rectHitTest, cursorForBboxMode, addWheelPassthrough — keep identical signatures and behaviour, so every importing sibling in the pack still resolves.

fix: A widget hidden by this helper must still be written into the saved workflow's widgets_values, and the node's widget list must still report it. On the ORIGINAL this fails: the helper overwrites `widget.type` with the string "converted-widget" + suffix, which is identity, so any code that branches on the widget's type (including the pack's own combo/number handling and litegraph's serializer path for converted widgets) no longer sees the real type, and the saved `origType`/`origComputeSize`/`origSerializeValue` bookkeeping is dead weight that nothing in this pack ever reads back to restore it — the widget can never be un-hidden. On the CONVERTED source `setHidden(true)` is presentation only: `widgetType` still reports the real type, the value is retained and serialized, and `setHidden(false)` restores it.
